sources.title: OpenAI o3-mini
sources.evidence: The January 31, 2025 announcement explicitly releases o3-mini in ChatGPT and the API that day, following a December preview. It describes three reasoning-effort settings, function calling and structured outputs, and explicitly excludes vision. Reopened October 27: small-model language and benchmark comparisons supply no nominal parameter count or named base with a disclosed count.

sources.title: o3-mini model reference
sources.evidence: Current exact-model reference lists snapshot o3-mini-2025-01-31, text input/output, 200,000 context tokens, 100,000 maximum output tokens, reasoning and function calling. It identifies a small alternative to o3, marks the model shut down, and lists cached input pricing of $0.55 per million tokens. Rechecked October 27 through the official documentation tool and the freshly fetched HTTP 200 Markdown; neither publishes total or active parameters.

sources.title: OpenAI o3-mini System Card publication
sources.evidence: The official January 31 publication links the working o3-mini-system-card-feb10.pdf. This is the source of the PDF URL used below, rather than an assumed filename. Reopened and followed that working link October 27; the old conventional filename is not treated as successfully retrieved evidence.

sources.title: OpenAI o3-mini System Card, February 10 revision
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27 via the official publication link and independently read the fresh HTTP 200 cached PDF (15:42 UTC; 37 pages). Sections 2–3 describe pretraining and reinforcement learning, and explicitly say the launch checkpoint adds incremental post-training to the same near-final base. Neither checkpoint receives a nominal size. Full-text count checks found no total or active count; final-parameters language and benchmark-task API parameters are not size disclosures.

sources.title: gpt-oss-120b & gpt-oss-20b Model Card
sources.evidence: Reread October 27 from the fresh HTTP 200 PDF (15:42 UTC). Table 1 explicitly counts only gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b; its active convention excludes embeddings and includes unembeddings. The exact o3-mini comparison in Table 2 and capability plots reports performance, not size, and establishes no named base/variant lineage allowing GPT-OSS counts to transfer.

sources.title: Deliberative Alignment: Reasoning Enables Safer Language Models
sources.evidence: Reread October 27 from the fresh HTTP 200 PDF (15:42 UTC). Sections 2.3.3–2.4 describe SFT and RL; section 2.4 explicitly names o3-mini as receiving the safety reward signal. Neither the training method nor exact-model results supply a nominal total, active count, or disclosed-size named base.

sources.title: Persona Features Control Emergent Misalignment
sources.evidence: Reread October 27 from the fresh HTTP 200 PDF (15:42 UTC). Section 2.5 studies o3-mini and a helpful-only version trained without safety data, without a nominal count for either. Sections 3.1 and D.1 use GPT-4o for SAE analysis; the 2.1-million latent dictionary and sparsity of 64 describe that SAE, not o3-mini parameters. Related-work small-model counts also cannot transfer.

sources.title: Prompt Caching 201, archived pre-GPT-5.6 recipe
sources.evidence: The explicit scope is models before GPT-5.6. Section 2.1 describes OpenAI prompt caching through Transformer layers, attention Q/K/V projections and reuse of cached keys and values. Together with exact o3-mini cached-input support, this supports only a qualified broad Transformer inference.

sources.title: API deprecations
sources.evidence: The April 22, 2026 legacy-model notice states that access was shut down on October 23, 2026 and explicitly includes both o3-mini-2025-01-31 and the o3-mini alias.

sources.title: API changelog: January 31, 2025
sources.evidence: The dated January 31 entry independently records the launch of o3-mini and o3-mini-2025-01-31, describing science, math and coding tasks.

sources.title: OpenAI Services Agreement
sources.evidence: Section 9.1 reserves intellectual-property rights in the service and grants only limited service-use rights; section 3.3 restricts reverse engineering. Together with the exact hosted release, this supports the descriptive Proprietary classification, not an open checkpoint license.

sources.title: All models: legacy and open-weight listings
sources.evidence: The current official catalog lists o3-mini among shut-down models and separately identifies gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b as Apache-licensed open-weight releases.

sources.title: Models.dev o3-mini upstream record
sources.evidence: The upstream lead uses December 20, 2024 and family o-mini. Its date conflicts with the first-party January 31 public launch; it is a preview-announcement date. Context and capabilities are independently confirmed by primary documentation. This catalog supplies no size evidence.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report, Table 13
sources.evidence: Opened the original report October 27. Table 13 exactly identifies OpenAI-o3-mini (medium) and has separate Architecture, # Activated Params and # Total Params rows. All three o3-mini cells are dashes while neighboring model counts are explicit. This later original model-team comparison provides neither a nominal total nor an active-count convention for o3-mini; medium is a reasoning-effort setting.

sources.title: o3-mini & Deepseek-R1 — rejected secondary estimate
sources.publisher: Prithiv Sakthi, Hugging Face community article
sources.evidence: Fresh targeted searches surfaced this February 2 community article, reopened October 27. Its comparison labels the total as an estimate around 200 billion and active parameters as full dense, without a supporting OpenAI count source. It is neither an OpenAI disclosure nor a model-team measurement of this checkpoint; both claims are rejected, and dense is not converted to an active count.

name.note: Official release name and API identifier.

developer.note: First-party announcement and system-card authorship identify OpenAI.

family.note: Normalize to o3: the exact reference identifies o3-mini as a small model alternative to o3. This does not transfer sibling specifications.

release_date.note: Contemporaneous public ChatGPT/API launch, independently recorded in the API changelog. The upstream December 20, 2024 date refers to the preview announcement; the baseline January 31 correction is retained.

open_weights.note: Hosted proprietary model; the official release and current catalog provide service access rather than an open checkpoint distribution.

license.note: Descriptive classification of limited hosted-service rights; no named open-weight license is asserted.

parameters_b.note: October 27 re-audit found no supported nominal total. Original OpenAI material gives no size for o3-mini, its near-final base or helpful-only variant; Qwen3 Table 13 leaves the exact model total blank. GPT-OSS performance similarity supplies no lineage, and the secondary estimated 200B claim is unsupported.

active_parameters_b.note: Checked independently October 27: no nominal active count is published in the reviewed OpenAI sources, and the explicit Activated Params row in Qwen3 Table 13 is a dash for o3-mini (medium). Neither GPT-OSS active counts, GPT-4o SAE latents nor an unsupported dense label establish this count.

architecture.note: Qualified broad inference: exact-model cached-input support binds o3-mini to the applicable pre-GPT-5.6 engineering explanation of Transformer attention and KV reuse. This is not an exact architecture specification. Dense versus MoE, layer count and other topology remain undisclosed; interpretability results for GPT-4o are not transferred.

context_window.note: Last-documented context limit. The separate maximum output is 100,000 tokens. The reference is historical specification evidence, not proof of a working endpoint after shutdown.

modalities.note: Exact-model reference is text-only, consistent with the launch explicitly excluding vision. Service tools and file handling do not establish native image, audio or PDF modalities.

reasoning.note: Original card and training research establish chain-of-thought reasoning with reinforcement learning; the launch offers low, medium and high effort settings.

tool_call.note: Exact-model launch and reference both explicitly support function calling.

description.value: Text-only reasoning model with adjustable reasoning effort, function calling, and structured outputs.
description.note: Replace relative price and planning language with directly documented model behavior.

patch.description: Text-only reasoning model with adjustable reasoning effort, function calling, and structured outputs.

sources.label: Qwen3 original comparison: o3-mini counts unreported

patch.notes: Released January 31, 2025 after a December 2024 preview. The o3-mini-2025-01-31 snapshot and alias were shut down on October 23, 2026. Last documented limits: 200,000 context tokens and 100,000 output tokens. Transformer is a broad inference from exact-model caching support and applicable OpenAI engineering documentation; detailed topology is undisclosed. Nominal total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed; Qwen3 Table 13 leaves both o3-mini count cells blank. Low, medium and high are reasoning-effort settings.

summary: Preserved the other 12 audited fields. Fresh October 27 review of the original launch, exact API reference, working system card, Deliberative Alignment, Persona Features and later GPT-OSS comparisons found no supported nominal total or active count. Added the Qwen team’s exact o3-mini comparison with separate blank total/active rows, evaluated the named near-final and helpful-only lineage, and rejected an unsupported secondary 200B/dense estimate. Both parameter assessments remain undisclosed with explicit null patch counts and parameters_source.
